//! Crate doc.
use std::fmt;

/// A point.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Point {
    x: i32,
    y: i32,
}

pub struct Unit;

/// Kinds.
enum Kind { A, B }

/// Shapes have areas.
pub trait Shape {
    fn area(&self) -> f64;
}

impl fmt::Display for Point {
    /// Formats.
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter) -> fmt::Result {
        write!(f, "({}, {})", self.x, self.y)
    }
}

impl Point {
    const ORIGIN: i32 = 0;

    pub fn new(x: i32, y: i32) -> Self {
        Point { x, y }
    }

    pub(crate) async fn later<'a>(&'a self) -> &'a i32 {
        &self.x
    }
}

/// Main.
pub const fn answer() -> i32 { 42 }

extern "C" fn callback() {}

macro_rules! m { () => {} }
